# Memomap / 기억지도 / 視える記憶 / 记忆地图

> A private map of the places you have already been. Tap the map to drop a pin, add a short memo and one photo. No account, no login, no subscription. Everything stays on the device.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://memomap.try-dabble.com/
Pins and memos are stored in this browser (localStorage key memomap:pins:v1); photos are stored in this device's IndexedDB database "memomap". No accounts, no subscription, no server-side storage, no sharing.

This is NOT a wishlist of places to visit and NOT a country-colouring map. It is a been-there memory map, and it does NOT require signing up to try.

## Pages

- [Home](https://memomap.try-dabble.com/): The map, the pins, the memos and the photos
- [Privacy](https://memomap.try-dabble.com/privacy.html): Privacy policy
- [Terms](https://memomap.try-dabble.com/terms.html): Terms of use
- [Guide](https://try-dabble.com/guides/memomap): How-to on try-dabble.com

## Features

- Free OpenStreetMap tiles via Leaflet. No Mapbox or Google Maps API key.
- Tap anywhere on the map to drop a pin at that spot
- One short memo per pin, saved as you type
- One optional photo per pin, from the photo library or the camera, kept on-device
- Pin list under the map; tap an entry to centre the map and open the memo
- Substring search across memo text
- Delete a pin, its memo and its photo in one step
- No login, no sign-up, no stamina or energy system, no daily cap
- No limit on how many photos you attach, no subscription, no paid tier
- Pins never expire and are never reset by an app update
- Private by default: no share links, no upload, nothing leaves the device
- Multi-language UI: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese
- Installable PWA with a network-first service worker
